pattern.description: The regular expression to search for.

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the current working directory.

glob.description: Optional glob filter, such as '*.py' or 'src/**/*.ts'.

output_mode.description: Use files_with_matches for filenames, content for matching lines with line numbers, or count for match counts per file.

context.description: Number of context lines to include before and after each match.

before_context.description: Number of lines to include before each match.

after_context.description: Number of lines to include after each match.

ignore_case.description: Whether the search should be case-insensitive.

type.description: Optional ripgrep file type, such as 'py', 'ts', 'js', or 'md'.

head_limit.description: Maximum number of returned matches. Use 0 only when full output is required.

offset.description: Match offset for paginating large result sets.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned by a previous Grep page. Do not combine with offset.
